integrity: All ordered pairs of 3x3 zero-one transition matrices are exhausted. Unambiguity is checked through the full generated matrix monoid under ordinary integer multiplication; mortality distances are exact breadth-first distances to zero, and a separately implemented Boolean-relation composition cross-checks every valid product.
scientific_limitations: The exact census is restricted to three-state binary unambiguous NFAs. It does not settle larger state counts or alphabets, and an unindexed small-state computation could contain the same equality classification.
title: Binary three-state unambiguous automata have mortality threshold \(6\) in one class
